verdict.rationale: SolidJS's source is publicly hosted on GitHub (github.com/solidjs/solid), and a community member cites its public commit history of about 1,823 commits, so the source is evidently readable. However, nothing in the pack names or confirms an open-source license. missing for 10: explicit evidence of an OSI-approved license (e.g., a LICENSE file or license statement), and independent corroboration of license terms.
